counting_method: Page-aware extracted text bounded by printed headings and reconciled against all 26 rendered pages. PDF page 2 contents and page 26 AI-use report are excluded from the 24-page technical denominator; references on page 24 are excluded by heading boundary. Image- or equation-dominant pages 8, 9, 14, 19, and 25 are counted from full-resolution renders. Running headers, watermarks, displayed equations, captions, pseudocode line numbers, and list markers are excluded from prose counts while their analytical content remains in content counts.
ambiguities: The six-paragraph Summary on page 1 is text-extractable and visually reconciled.
Introduction includes the opening quotation, background, three task-restatement blocks, and the Our Work roadmap because together they form the complete opening architecture.

The bridge model is split at section 5.3: graph, congestion, and stakeholder definitions are model-establishment; the A*-GA route solver is algorithm; edge deletion and before-after interpretation are results.
Section 6 is mapped to model-improvement because it adds a bus project to the common Baltimore network and includes diagnosis, optimization, Monte Carlo, solution, and stakeholder comparison.
Section 7 is mapped to problem-analysis because it selects low-availability communities, defines a composite index, formulates an ADP-labeled redesign, and interprets the project.
Section 8 is mapped to future-improvements because the four-module safety software is a proposed application rather than a validated safety model.
The memo on page 25 is image-layer content and is counted visually as seven paragraph blocks after the salutation.
Page 24 combines sensitivity interpretation, evaluation, and references; heading boundaries exclude references from the language chapters.
